name: Black Guy Stopping
look: Two stacked stills from a commercial on a city sidewalk. Top: a woman in a white striped crop top walks past a storefront as a man in a gray T-shirt turns to go after her. Bottom: a Black man in a red plaid shirt puts a hand on the gray-shirt man's chest to stop him.
use: Someone is about to chase a tempting but bad idea and a friend stops them. Usually the woman is the temptation, the man in gray is the one tempted, and the man in plaid is the voice of reason or the responsibility holding him back.
slots: whoever stops him (man in plaid, bottom)
examples: The 40 games I haven't played yet
describe: guy stops his friend from going after a woman walking by
man in a plaid shirt puts a hand on his buddy's chest
friend holding back another guy from chasing a girl
black man stops his friend from following a woman
two panel commercial where a man blocks his friend on the sidewalk
origin: From Gillette's 2019 ad The Best Men Can Be, in a scene where one man stops another from following a woman.
